snippet.title: Hey Don't Look At Me | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Hey, Don't Look at Me, a psychological horror game developed by GMD13 and FROGIX. Players will move into their deceased grandmother's apartment to embark on a new chapter in life. Observe supernatural entities from afar, make use of objects, and seek the truth behind a nosy neighbor. Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4551470/Hey_Dont_Look_at_Me
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
